# Acta Sanctorum

> English translation of the Acta Sanctorum, the Bollandists' collection of
> hagiographic texts (lives, passions, and miracle collections of the
> saints, organized by feast day), January through August so far.

Latin source text is public domain. The English translation, editorial
apparatus (headnotes, genre tags, marginalia/marker inventory), and
encoding are CC BY-NC 4.0, attribution "Wilson Pruitt (Wroot Press)".
Machine-learning training and retrieval are explicitly permitted under
those terms, including for commercial model development — see the
Machine Use section at https://actasanctorum.org/rights.html

## Structure
- One canonical page per saint entry: https://actasanctorum.org/<month>/day-<NN>/<slug>.html
- Every saint page has plain-text and JSON siblings: replace .html with
  .txt or .json in the URL.
- Bulk export (all saint entries, one JSON record each):
  https://actasanctorum.org/export.html

## Credits
Latin source digitized by the Ökumenisches Heiligenlexikon
(heiligenlexikon.de), supplemented by manual transcription from the Paris
edition.
